meta.name: add-emacs
meta.description: Add Emacs as a channel. Opens an interactive chat buffer and org-mode integration so you can talk to NanoClaw from within Emacs (Doom, Spacemacs, or vanilla). Local HTTP bridge — no bot token or external service needed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在 Emacs 中与 AI 对话，无需外部服务
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你用 Emacs 并想直接在编辑器里与 AI 交互
copy.tagline_en: Chat with AI inside Emacs, no external service needed
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Emacs and want to interact with AI directly from your editor

howto.what: 安装后，你可以在 Emacs 里直接和 AI 助手聊天，或者把 Org 文件中的内容发送给 AI，AI 的回复会以子标题的形式插入到你的 Org 文件中。
howto.when: 当你按下聊天快捷键（如 C-c n c）打开聊天缓冲区，或者按下发送快捷键（如 C-c n o）发送当前 Org 子树或区域时触发。

say.text: 帮我解释一下这个函数的作用。
say.note: 选中代码后发送，AI 会给出解释。

say.text: 把这段会议记录总结成要点。
say.note: 发送 Org 议程条目，AI 返回摘要。

howto.what_en: After installation, you can chat with the AI assistant directly from Emacs, or send Org file content to the AI; the reply appears as a child heading in your Org file.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you open the chat buffer with a keybinding (e.g., C-c n c) or send the current Org subtree/region with a keybinding (e.g., C-c n o).

say_en.note: Select code and send; AI explains.

say_en.text: Summarize these meeting notes into action items.
say_en.note: Send Org agenda entry; AI returns summary.
